The Story

Born on
Cave Mountain

"There is a bear that lives behind our house on Cave Mountain. Our daughters call him the Mountain King."

It started with a black bear and two little girls. The Dorans' daughters spotted him behind their house on Cave Mountain Road in Windham — big, unhurried, crowned by the hemlocks. They named him the Mountain King. When the family opened a brewery on Main Street in 2022, the name was never a question.

We're a family operation at 5351 Main Street, four minutes from the Windham Mountain base lodge and a half-mile from the Elm Ridge trailhead. The Batavia Kill runs through our backyard. Every beer is tied to this place — the water, the peaks, the seasons that turn the mountain outside our taproom window.

Come for the beer. Stay for the story about the bear.

2020
The bear appears on Cave Mountain. The girls name him.

Brewery opens on Main Street, Windham.

10 beers on tap. The King still reigns.

Greetings from Windham, New York · Catskill Mountains
The mountain is quiet this morning. The King was spotted near Cave Mountain again at dawn — crown gleaming, unbothered. The new batch is cold and ready. Come find us on Main Street. The fire is on, the dogs are welcome, and the King reigns as always.
— The Doran Family
Mountain King Brewing Co.
The Year on the Mountain

Four Seasons,
One Crown

The mountain runs on its own calendar — and so does our brewhouse. Every season gets its own beer, its own story, its own reason to climb.

01 / Spring
Big
Hollow
The first warm weekend, trailheads crowded, the valley greening up. Pairs with a hike
02 / Summer
Sunshine
Wheat
Porch afternoons, kids in the grass, the sun past the peaks. Pairs with the porch
03 / Fall
Oktober­fest
Leaves turning, boots laced, the first real chill after dark. Pairs with the fire
04 / Winter
Winter
Lager
Last run of the day, boots off, the lift lines finally quiet. Pairs with après-ski
